svg.title: ПДн Контроль — Deployment Diagram (Deployment View, MVP v2)

g.text: ПДн Контроль — Deployment Diagram (Deployment View, MVP v2)
One `docker compose up` brings up all services.
Only Caddy (:443) is exposed to the internet;
internal service ports are reachable only on the
Compose network (dev maps them to localhost).
